name: MCE Processing Summary
query:
SELECT
  posting_date as "Posting Date:Date:110",
  transaction_type as "Type:Data:80",
  COUNT(*) as "Total:Int:80",
  SUM(CASE WHEN validation_status = 'Accepted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Accepted:Int:90",
  SUM(CASE WHEN validation_status = 'Rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Rejected:Int:90",
  SUM(CASE WHEN docstatus = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Submitted:Int:90",
  SUM(CASE WHEN validation_status = 'Accepted' AND docstatus = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Pending Submission:Int:140"
FROM `tabMCE Inventory Transaction`
GROUP BY posting_date, transaction_type
ORDER BY posting_date DESC, transaction_type
